empty.title: The catalog is empty
empty.body: Add your first book to get started.

catalog.coverFailed: The cover could not be downloaded.

form.title: Add a book
form.description: Only the title is required. If the ISBN is already in the catalog, a new copy is added to that edition.

errors.out_of_range: This value is out of range.
errors.invalid_date: This is not a valid date.
errors.isbn_character: An ISBN may only contain digits (and a final X).
errors.isbn_checksum: This ISBN is not valid: check for a typo.
errors.isbn_in_use: Another book in the catalog already has this ISBN.
errors.invalid_cover_url: This cover address is not allowed.
errors.invalid_format: Unknown format. Use hardcover, paperback, pocket, ebook, audiobook or other.

history.title: History
history.empty: No recorded changes. Books added before change history existed have none.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
deleteConfirm.body: The edition and all its copies will be removed from the catalog. Authors and owners stay.

copies.empty: No copies: this edition is in the catalog but nobody owns it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this copy?
deleteConfirm.body: The edition stays in the catalog.

lookup.placeholder: Type or scan and press Enter
lookup.found: Found in {{sources}}. Check the data before saving.
lookup.notFound: Not found in the online catalogues. You can fill it in by hand.
lookup.alreadyInCatalog: This edition is already in the catalog: saving will add another copy.
lookup.googleQuota: Google Books refused the request (quota exhausted). Add your own free API key in Settings for better results.
lookup.failed: The search failed. Check your connection.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Stored only on this device: never synced or exported.
settings.googleBooksHelp: Without a key, Google Books often refuses requests. Create a free key in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials) with the Books API enabled.

burst.title: Quick add
burst.description: Type or scan ISBNs one after another. Found books are saved at once with the copy details below; nothing is duplicated.
burst.summary: {{added}} added · {{exists}} already in the catalog · {{pending}} to review

status.exists: Already in the catalog: not added

data.title: Your data
data.description: A backup is a .zip with every book, copy and cover, restorable on any device. CSV is one row per copy, for spreadsheets and other apps.
data.csvImported: Imported: {{books}} new books, {{copies}} copies added to existing books, {{rejected}} rows rejected.

backupErrors.not_a_backup: This file is not a backup of this app.
backupErrors.unreadable: The backup is damaged and cannot be read.
backupErrors.other_version: This backup was made with a different version of the app.
backupErrors.not_empty: A backup can only be restored into an empty catalog. Delete the books first, or use a fresh install.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Sync this catalog with your other devices over your home network. No server and no account: the connection is encrypted and only works between paired devices.
devices.showCodeHelp: On the other device, scan this code or paste the text in “Devices”. It works once, for 10 minutes.
devices.enterCodeHelp: Or paste here the code another device is showing:

forgetConfirm.title: Forget {{name}}?
forgetConfirm.body: You will have to pair again to sync with it. Nothing is deleted from the catalog.

errors.bad_code: That is not a pairing code.
errors.same_device: That code belongs to this same device.
errors.unreachable: The other device cannot be reached. Is it on the same Wi-Fi, with the app open?
errors.wrong_certificate: The device that answered is not the one in the code. Pairing was stopped for safety.
errors.rejected: The other device refused: the code expired or was already used, or it forgot this device.
errors.other_version: The two devices run different versions of the app. Update both.
errors.peer_error: The other device had a problem. Try again.
errors.no_network: This device is not connected to any network.

check.title: Do I already have it?
check.description: Scan or type an ISBN. The answer comes from the catalog on this device, so it works without coverage.
check.wishTitle: Title, to add it to the wishlist
check.addToCatalog: I bought it: add to catalog
check.cameraDenied: The app needs camera permission to scan. Allow it in the phone's settings.

empty.title: The wishlist is empty
empty.body: Use “Do I have it?” in a bookshop to note books you do not have yet.
